entities.summary: Air Marshal Ahmed Mohamed Shafik Zaki is an Egyptian politician and former presidential candidate. He served as commander in the Egyptian Air Force and later served as Prime Minister of Egypt from 29 January 2011 to 3 March 2011 under Hosni Mubarak.
